“the stakes for our coverage has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our coverage have never been higher”

“federal goverment's” >>> “federal government's”

“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”

“three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: the text says there are three cosponsors but names only two]

“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”

“central principal” >>> “central principle”

“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”

“directly effect” >>> “directly affect”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: the memo earlier identifies Whitfield as R-OH]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: Section 4 establishes the registry; Section 5 covers penalties]

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty” >>> [CHECK: Section 5 earlier says civil penalties are up to $1 million per day]

“Senator Grant, who's support” >>> “Senator Grant, whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“Senator Gallager” >>> “Senator Gallagher”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”

“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: these figures total 29, not 28]

“undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> [CHECK: this names five senators, but the preceding count says six are undecided]

“October 14” >>> “October 15” [CHECK: the memo gives the markup date as October 15]

“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”

“the list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “the list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”

“hearing ... occured” >>> “hearing ... occurred”

“within two years” >>> [CHECK: Section 6 says negotiations must begin within 18 months; the memo doesn’t specify a two-year deadline]

“a close compliment” >>> “a close complement”

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“to there senators” >>> “to their senators”

“you should recieve” >>> “you should receive”

“six Hill reporters” / “Each of our five Hill reporters” >>> [CHECK: the memo gives two different counts for Hill reporters]
